generation_instructions.label: Name only the Python standard-library module described in the source passage, without explanation.
generation_instructions.summary: Explain the module purpose in two clear sentences, using the provided documentation.
generation_instructions.detailed: Give a detailed explanation of the module purpose, suitable use cases, and one caveat, based on the documentation. Write about 100 words.

limitations: New content domain but documents from local standard library; not externally collected user prompts
Output questions are synthetic and module names appear in source
